# Assessment {#assessment .unnumbered}

All the important information related to the unit asssessment is available on **Canvas** [here](). 

This includes aims, assessment criteria and rubrics, expectations on the use of AI, formatting instructions (e.g., word count, referencing), and advice on structure and potential points of discussion. 

While the assessments are independent pieces of work, there is lots of support available. You can:

- talk to Matt, TAs or the GIS Technical Specialists during class time.
- use the [**discussion forums**](). 
- attend weekly student **consultation hours** (in-person or online), listed on the Student Support Hours Google Sheet. 
- contact the teaching team via **email**, although we strongly encourage students to make use of the forum, as the visible repository of question-answers is beneficial to the entire student cohort, unlike a private email exchange.
- make use of School-level GIS support via **GISTechnical**.
